comment: 54yo female with NAFLD/MASLD on imaging (hepatic steatosis grade 2-3 on US) + metabolic syndrome (BMI 34, T2DM on metformin, dyslipidemia). FibroScan 12.5 kPa indicating advanced fibrosis (F3-F4 zone). FIB-4 score 2.9. No prior alcohol exposure, no viral hepatitis. MASLD with advanced fibrosis is a major emerging HCC etiology (~15-20% of HCC in Western populations). Fires RF-CHRONIC-NAFLD-MASLD-HCC-PREVENTION. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-CHRONIC-NAFLD-MASLD-HCC-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (US ± AFP q6mo HCC surveillance per AASLD 2023 + weight loss + GLP-1 agonist consideration); alternative = IND-CHRONIC-NAFLD-MASLD-HCC-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (closer hepatology follow-up without routine HCC imaging if non-cirrhotic).
